description: Creates a NEW database, billed like any other, whose data is an instant copy of this one (for a test or staging copy), with the same users and passwords. It stays linked to its source for up to 7 days (no backups of its own, the source cannot be deleted) unless detach_database_fork ends that sooner. Retrying the same call is safe. Scope: vms.create.

size_gb.description: Memory in GB, one of the sizes of get_database_options for the region. Default: 1, or the source's size.

vpc.description: Default: the source's private network; same region either way.

name: fork_database
title: Fork a database
